card.title: Meet the devices
card.robot: A needle-guidance robot like Perfint MAXIO or Quantum Surgical Epione: it aims a guide along each planned path, and the radiologist pushes the needle through it.
card.console: An argon cryoablation system like Boston Scientific Visual-ICE: it runs several needles at once, freezes their tips to about -150 °C, and thaws them actively at the end.
card.honesty: Simulated. Robot-guided needle placement was accurate in early studies (about 1-2 mm at the tip), but robot plus cryoablation is still an emerging combination. The times and temperatures here are illustrative.
